messages:
sam: P0 from BrightCart — Dedicated pool didn't scale quickly during their morning spike. They saw ~90s of 429s and some 504s. Customer says spike aligned with their service-token rotation. Raising to triage.

lisa-cs: Adding their timeline + customer logs: token rotate at 2024-09-12T10:02:13Z, traffic jump at 10:02:30Z, first 429s at 10:02:33Z. They attached a short log snippet.

alex: looking into autoscaler events for rc-prod-dedicated-52 now. Can someone post the autoscaler panel link?

ops-bot: ALERT: autoscale_delay detected on pool rc-prod-dedicated-52; backlog=230; probe_failures=3; last_scale_event=+00:00:45 ago. https://console.redwood/internal/alerts/4490001234

maria: Do we know pool config? suspect min_replicas floor + failing preflight probes blocked fast ramp.

ryan: quick curl from customer-sim:
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <rotated-token>" https://inference.redwood/v1/predict
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-redwood-retry-after: 30
x-redwood-error: attach-handshake-failed
```

sam: Customer log shows attach-agent errors: "attach handshake: auth denied" repeated, then attach queued. Looks like attach failures coincided with token change.

alex: I can see attach-agent returned 401->429 cascade for that tenant for ~35s after rotation. Autoscaler saw pod readiness failing (preflight) and decided not to scale because newly spawned pods failed probes and were evicted from the warmchain.

maria: So two compounding things: (1) short auth outage from token rotation causing probe failures, (2) min_replicas low + aggressive probe policy -> autoscaler underestimates headroom and delays new replica creation.

ryan: Repro steps I ran in staging: rotate token + fire steady 300qps -> attach handshake errors -> preflight probe backoff -> HPA/scale controller suppressed for ~40s.

alex: Immediate mitigation: bump min_replicas on the customer's pool to 4 (from 2) and relax preflight probe backoff window to 5s for this tenant. Applying now.

ops-bot: ACTION: update applied to rc-prod-dedicated-52: min_replicas=4, probe_backoff_ms=5000 (by alex).

lisa-cs: Customer reports recovery: 429s dropped within 60s after change, traffic fully served now. They asked for root cause and prevention suggestions.

sam: Suggested long-term fixes to share: - coordinate token rotations via control-plane hook (graceful attach handover) - add transient burst capacity / warmpool for high-frequency customers - change probe policy to tolerate short auth blips during rotation

maria: Also recommend adding a small default warmpool headroom for customers doing rolling key rotations; ops-runbook note.

ryan: Filed INF-4123 for engineering: "attach handshake during token rotation can trigger probe backoff -> scale delay." Assigning to eng-runtime to investigate attach retry/backoff logic and autoscaler heuristics.

alex: I'll follow up on INF-4123 and add traces linking attach errors to scale decisions. :thumbsup:

sam: Thanks everyone — marking customer notified and mitigation applied. Leaving thread open for ENG follow-up.

ops-bot: STATUS: mitigation succeeded, customer confirmed. Incident state -> monitoring for 2h.
